segments.speaker: narrator
segments.displayText: It was almost eleven at night on a remote island somewhere in the Atlantic Ocean. The island stretched roughly fifty-six kilometers across, about thirty-five miles from one side to the other, but most of it remained undeveloped wilderness. Near its center sat a research settlement of laboratories, homes, workshops, medical facilities, and other buildings supporting the nearly five hundred people who lived there.
